¿Cuál es el largo de un mensaje de texto: How long can an SMS text message be?
Un mensaje SMS tiene hasta 160 caractere: An SMS message has up to 160 characters in UTF-8 format (UCS Transformation Format 8). If the selected route supports special characters, the limit may be lower depending on the characters used.
Si la ruta permite mensajes largos, tamb: If the route allows long messages, the space available per message is also reduced: the protocol uses 20 characters to identify the previous and next messages so the device can put them in order.
Los mensajes de texto utilizan el format: Text messages use UTF-8 format (UCS Transformation Format 8). Some Latin characters, such as Á, É, Í, Ó, Ú, Ñ, á, é, í, ó, ú, ñ, ä, ë, ï, ö, ü and ¿, can take more space than a basic character and reduce the message's available length.
